platform: Flo Bank Multi-Workshop Enterprise AI & API Gateway Platform

unverified_requirements.reason: Host execution environment is Linux VPS (vmi3355051 / Ubuntu x86_64). Linux VPS peak active memory profile usage measured at ~775–995 MB (740–949 MiB) across 9 containers (comfortably within the 6 GB VPS operating budget), but actual participant Windows 11 WSL2 virtualization overhead remains unverified until tested on native Windows participant hardware.

architectural_notes.w3_langgraph_agent: Compiled LangGraph state machine (src/worker/dispute_agent.py) supporting dual modes: live MiniMax reasoning via APISIX Gate 1 or deterministic offline replay fixtures, invoking allowlisted Gate 2/3 MCP tools and enforcing server-side governance.
architectural_notes.built_image_tags: API, adapter, worker, and temporal images use local semantic tags 1.0.0; the customer demo uses flo-bank-demo:local. Dockerfiles use python:3.12-slim with pinned Python requirements. Third-party runtime image digests are listed in pinned_images.
architectural_notes.customer_demo: The demo profile runs a three-service topology (demo, demo-gateway, demo-inference) using fictional session fixtures and live MiniMax 2.7 Fast (MiniMax-M2.7-highspeed) chat via APISIX Gate 1 with allowlisted session tools, or deterministic offline scripted mode. In DEMO_BACKEND_MODE=enterprise (or via the demo-enterprise profile), Flo Bank interacts in real time with APISIX Gate 3 (:9080/api/v1) for live customer account balances, card freeze/unfreeze mutations, and support case disputes with scoped JWT auth and distributed tracing.
